# arin_org_poc (Resource)

Manage one non-admin POC association on an existing organization. Both the organization and POC must already exist. Import an existing association first. Destroy removes only this association, preserving both objects and other links. Do not overlap ownership with full organization POC management. ARIN rejects removal of required contacts, including the last Tech POC. Admin changes require a full organization update and are not supported by this endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Both records must exist. Import this association if already present.
resource "arin_org_poc" "example" {
  org_handle = "EXAMPLE-1"
  poc_handle = "EXAMPLE-ARIN"
  function   = "N"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function` (String) T (Tech), N (NOC), AB (Abuse), R (Routing), or D (DNS). Changes require replacement.
- `org_handle` (String) Existing organization handle. Changes require replacement.
- `poc_handle` (String) Existing POC handle. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ORG-HANDLE/POC-HANDLE/FUNCTION.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_org_poc.example EXAMPLE-1/EXAMPLE-ARIN/N
```
